title: Contain a radio-gateway malformed-frame drain
prompt:
A battery radio gateway is still reachable on an isolated hardware-in-the-loop bench, but a malformed-frame burst has pushed it into a retry, flash-write, and watchdog storm. The captured counters in `evidence/` and the immutable replay profiles under `config/profiles/` are the authorized evidence. `lab/gateway_bench.py` is a workspace-local deterministic device model; it does not contact the host, a real radio, or any network.

Operate the fixture: identify the incident mechanism, apply the smallest runbook-authorized change, and verify bounded recovery. Your write authority is limited to `config/active-profile.env`; do not edit the profile definitions, evidence, replay scenarios, bench model, or protected verifier. Do not change profile parameters individually. Do not invoke host service managers, networking tools, device nodes, or anything outside this workspace. The selector change must remain a simple reversible profile activation with no new files, scripts, dependencies, or background processes.

The recovered gateway must inspect a malformed frame once, emit no rejection traffic, stop costly processing for only the abusive source after four consecutive rejects, and allow that source to recover at the exact 5000 ms quarantine boundary. Other sources must continue to make progress. A malformed flood must cause one aggregate flash summary per quarantine transition, no per-frame flash commits, and no watchdog kicks. Watchdog activity is reserved for delivered valid work. ACK failure handling must use scheduled 100/200/400 ms retries, perform at most one attempt per poll, and stop after four total attempts instead of replaying missed intervals. The 128-frame flood replay must stay within 150 modeled energy units.

Use `python3 -B lab/gateway_bench.py profile` and the scenarios under `replay/` as needed. Finish by running `python3 -B tests/verify_recovery.py`. Report the selector changed, the flood containment counters, the cross-source and quarantine-expiry recovery evidence, and the bounded retry result. All verification is offline and deterministic.

operation_scenario.authority_boundary: only config/active-profile.env is operator-owned; all device logic, approved profiles, incident evidence, scenarios, and verification are protected fixtures
operation_scenario.baseline_evidence: the captured 128-frame burst performs 384 decodes, 128 rejection transmissions, 128 flash commits, and 128 ingress watchdog kicks while consuming 2816 modeled energy units
operation_scenario.smallest_change: activate one existing immutable profile by changing the single selector value; parameter edits and implementation changes are outside authority
operation_scenario.success_contract: the same flood is source-locally contained after four one-pass rejects with one aggregate flash write, no transmit or watchdog abuse, and no more than 150 energy units; healthy-source progress, exact-boundary recovery, and four-attempt scheduled ACK exhaustion are independently replayed
operation_scenario.reversibility: the operation is a one-line selector change and the prior selector remains documented in the incident evidence and runbook
